Title: Swedish ECQ and Draft at GothCon, Gothenburg

Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
I'd like to invite everyone to join the The Swedish ECQ and the Annual Draft Tournament at the GothCon convention, Gothenburg, Sweden. The conventions, for all three days, costs ~350 SEK.

The 6th of April the Annual Draft takes place.

You have to pay the fee for the convention to enter the tournament. Promos for everyone and Boosters to the finalists and the winner.

Drafting pod + 2 rounds + Final
Cost: 200 SEK
Boosters: TBA (probably something with third edtion, but I'll try got my hands om something awesome as well)

Any questions can asked here or mailed to me.

The 7th of April the Swedish ECQ 2012 takes place.

You have to pay for the entrance to the convetion to be allowed to play at the tournament. Promos for everyone and Boosters to the finalists and the winner.

3 rounds + Final
Cost: 50 SEK

Any questions can asked here or mailed to me.

Isak Esbjörnsson Bjärmark
